fashion_rules: Use neutral footwear when the outfit already has a strong statement colour or print.
Use one dominant colour and one or two supporting colours for an easy coordinated look.
Analogous colours create harmonious combinations; complementary colours create stronger contrast.
Match formality: formal shoes with tailored/formal looks, casual sneakers or sandals with casual looks.
Coordinate accessory metal tones when useful, but mixing metals can be an intentional styling choice.
Keep statement accessories limited when the clothing already has a bold print or strong texture.
For Indian occasions, footwear and jewellery can shift the same outfit from everyday to festive.
Weather, venue, comfort and walking needs should affect footwear recommendations.
Color-analysis recommendations are styling suggestions, not objective rules; lighting and personal preference matter.
trend_2026_notes: Slim retro sneakers, expressive colours, textured accessories and personality-led styling are prominent 2026 themes.
Burgundy, olive, cream, camel, jewel tones and metallic accents are useful palette options.
Modern derbies, loafers, ballet-inspired shoes, sandals and refined sneakers cover a broad range of current styling directions.
